_comment: The standard curator policy preset. The signer loads it (CURATOR_POLICY_FILE), validates it and refuses to boot on an unknown or missing key. Every number is a refusal threshold: the signer refuses, it never clamps. Change it by editing this file and restarting the signer. The portfolio mint, treasury, guardian and expected curator are env (CURATOR_PORTFOLIO_MINT, CURATOR_TREASURY, CURATOR_EXPECTED_GUARDIAN, the keypair), not policy.

universe._comment: A pool may be targeted only when every row here passes. `allowlist` is by catalogue symbol; pools with no price feed and every pool on another chain are out by construction. Refusals: CHAIN_DENIED, POOL_DENIED (allowlist, riskTier, pythFeedId), POOL_NOT_ACTIVE, POOL_COST_TOO_HIGH.

categories._comment: The catalogue rows carry no category, so it lives here. Every allowlisted pool must be in exactly one category (loadPolicy checks). `stable` is the band-limited one.

shape._comment: 3–8 legs and |held ∪ new| ≤ 8 (one apply page; curator.js pages over held ∪ new); per leg 5 %–min(40 %, pool maxWeightBps); stablecoins 10–40 % combined; any category ≤ 60 %; weights sum to 10000. Refusals: MIN_LEGS, MAX_LEGS, PAGE_LIMIT, LEG_WEIGHT_CAP, STABLE_BAND, CATEGORY_CAP, WEIGHTS_SUM.

turnover._comment: sum |Δw|/2 per proposal, against the current target weights. Refusal: TURNOVER_CAP.

cost._comment: sum |Δw_i| × maxExecutionLossBps_i / 10000, in bps of NAV. Refusal: COST_CAP.

cadence._comment: Since on-chain last_rebalance_at; quota over the journal ledger; none while pending_targets; none unless inputs (trailingYieldBps, tvlUsdc, riskTier per targeted pool) are present unless the proposal is a risk exit; propose only inside the UTC window so effectiveAt lands in the owner's day. Refusals: PROPOSAL_TOO_SOON, PROPOSAL_QUOTA, TARGETS_PENDING, INPUTS_INCOMPLETE, OUTSIDE_WINDOW.

reason._comment: `why` on propose and cancel, journaled. Refusal: WHY_REQUIRED.

deposit._comment: USD per UTC day; launch-day cap applies when `launchDay` (YYYY-MM-DD) is today; book priceState must be fresh; amount/price ≤ min(cap headroom, max_total_idle − total_idle, per-user headroom) read from VaultConfig. Refusals: DEPOSIT_DAILY_CAP, BOOK_NOT_FRESH, CAP_HEADROOM.

withdraw._comment: Chat sessions only; USD per UTC day; always to the signer's own ATA. Refusals: WITHDRAW_CRON_BLOCKED, WITHDRAW_DAILY_CAP.

verbs._comment: Route names. `agent` with the agent token; `ops` with the ops token only (OPS_ONLY); `denied` never through the signer by anyone (VERB_DENIED): curator transfer/accept/cancel, fee recipient, revive and create are the owner's wallet actions; `cronDenied` refused when X-Curator-Session is cron or absent (WITHDRAW_CRON_BLOCKED).

rate._comment: Write attempts (ok or not) per rolling hour; the signer refuses to sign under the lamport floor (0.02 SOL). Refusals: RATE_LIMITED, LOW_SOL.

invariants._comment: Checked every tick against chain reads: portfolio.curator == expected, pending_curator == None, rebalance_delay_secs == this, accountant.recipient1 == treasury, factory.guardian == expected, composition_locked == false. Drift => self-lock all writes + alert (SELF_LOCKED / INVARIANT_DRIFT); only POST /unlock (ops) clears it once the drift is gone.

apply._comment: state machine timings, in seconds unless named otherwise. The loop ticks every `tickSecs`; the machine arms `armBeforeEffectiveSecs` before effectiveAt and gives up `windowAfterEffectiveSecs` after it. `escalateAfterSecs` per blocker; 0 = escalate immediately; null = never (blocked instead).

review._comment: Wake triggers for the curator-review cron: monthly thesis review on the first Monday; a leg under target for `legNeedsInflowGates` consecutive gates with no inflow for `legNoInflowDays` and the top-up budget spent; a publisher park older than `publisherParkHours`; a 30 d return under `drawdown30dPct`.
